title: A weak-signal proper score recovers linear TV-to-feature distortion

statement.quantifiers: X~N(theta,I_d), 0<r<=1; blind same archive before coordinate i is chosen; each query decoder reconstructs ONLY scalar laws at theta=+/-r e_i within TV epsilon.
statement.assertion: Posterior p_r(x)=(1+tanh(rx))/2; u_r(p)=tanh(arctanh(2p-1)/r). Bounded proper loss in [0,1] from convex antiderivative F_r satisfies D_F(p,q)>=r|u_r(p)-u_r(q)|²/4. With u_r(p_r(x))=tanh x, under common null P0, E(tanh X_i-tanh Y_i)²<=4sqrt(e)epsilon/r, and I(X_i;Y_i,S)>=.5 log(r/epsilon)-1.25-log2.
assumptions: Decoder independent of unknown mean/sign; Markov T-(X,S)-Y_i.
Independent public seed allowed; accuracy only seed-average.
Same measurable stored state and own scalar query output; null law is analytic reference, no reconstruction requirement at theta0.

inputs: Sparse Gaussian alternative pairs and chosen coordinate query.
outputs: Weak-signal linear epsilon/r distortion bound; scalar information demand.
interface.precision: TV bounded loss avoids unbounded risk; 0<r<=1 exact calibration.
costs: Total hybrid dimension D=sum_j d_j counts all input-dependent classical registers.
No free entangled receiver reference or retained real record.

proof_mechanism: Calibrate feature so inverse posterior derivative>=r/2.
Bregman integral controls feature squared error; bounded loss and TV imply regret<=epsilon.
Pair-mixture density >=exp(-r²/2) relative to null; tanh Gaussian entropy and entropy-distortion inequality yield information.
obstructions: Fixed Brier score at vanishing r loses sharp weak-signal factor.
Supplying mean sign would let decoder sample target without archive.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Construct a bounded proper score calibrated to stable feature and prove destination reference-density floor.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
